assets.defect_engineered: Colourless blind-emboss photographed in raking light from the left: relief and cream stock are the same warm cream, so the seal reads only as shadow. Along the RIGHT side of the ring the light falls away and relief and stock sit at the same luminance, so a selection has nothing to hold and silently loses an arc of the rope border and part of the founding year 1978 - the mask still looks like a seal and the trace still succeeds. Fires checkpoint-after-step-6.

The off-level frame: a clean/correct black point but the whole image sits about one degree off level, and the composition fills the frame with almost no spare margin, so auto-straightening rotates and crops into exactly the edge the programme-cover crop wants. This is the hall interior the cover uses.
